import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from utils import run_request
from ref import Ref


def check(name, cfg, expected_log, expected_state=None):
    req = {"runs": [cfg]}
    got = run_request(req)["runs"][0]
    ok = got["log"] == expected_log
    if expected_state is not None:
        ok = ok and got["state"] == expected_state
    ref = Ref(cfg)
    rlog = ref.run(cfg["events"])
    rok = got["log"] == rlog and got["state"] == ref.certificate()
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name +
          ("  [ref agrees]" if rok else "  [REF DISAGREES]"))
    if not ok:
        print("  got log:", json.dumps(got["log"]))
        print("  exp log:", json.dumps(expected_log))
        if expected_state is not None:
            print("  got st:", json.dumps(got["state"]))
            print("  exp st:", json.dumps(expected_state))


# A: pushout keeps longest prefix, evicted_ids in descending (rank, ordinal)
cfg = {"banks": 1, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 10,
       "refill_batch": 3, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 10],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "events": [["enqueue", 1, 1, 4, 5], ["enqueue", 2, 1, 4, 5],
                  ["enqueue", 3, 1, 4, 7], ["dequeue", 1]]}
check("pushout-prefix", cfg,
      [[0, "enqueue", 1, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "enqueue", 2, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [2, "enqueue", 3, 7, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [3, "dequeue", 0, 0, 1, 5, 0, 0, [3]]],
      {"tick": 1, "load_balancer": 0, "service_bank": 0, "sample_progress": 3,
       "borders": [0, 10], "counters": [[[3]]], "history": [0],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "queues": [{"fifo": [], "pifo": [2], "fifo_bytes": 0, "pifo_bytes": 4}],
       "lags": [[2, 0]]})

# B: everything pushed out -> idle visit still reports evicted ids
cfg = {"banks": 1, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 3,
       "refill_batch": 2, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 10],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "events": [["enqueue", 1, 1, 5, 1], ["dequeue", 1]]}
check("idle-with-eviction", cfg,
      [[0, "enqueue", 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "dequeue", 0, 0, None, None, 0, 0, [1]]])

# C: lag bumps lower-rank residents on high-rank service; equal ranks frozen

       "refill_batch": 2, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 20],

                  ["dequeue", 3], ["inspect", 3], ["inspect", 4]]}
# visit1: refill {1,2} serve 1(rank1); visit2: pifo has 2 -> serve 2(rank9): bumps 3,4 (rank5<9)
# visit3: refill {3,4} serve 3(rank5): bumps 4? 4 rank5 == 5 no -> lag 1 stays
check("lag-bump", cfg,
      [[0, "enqueue", 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "enqueue", 2, 9, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [2, "enqueue", 3, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [3, "enqueue", 4, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [4, "dequeue", 0, 0, 1, 1, 3, 0, []],
       [4, "dequeue", 1, 0, 2, 9, 1, 0, []],

# D: rank_error counts other stages/banks globally

       "refill_batch": 1, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 20],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "events": [["enqueue", 1, 1, 1, 5], ["dequeue", 2], ["dequeue", 1]]}
# id1 -> bank1 (r=0: C[0][q][0] all 0, tie smallest q -> bank 0!). recompute: r=0 (rank5 in [0,20)),
# C[0][q][0]=1 when q < 0 mod 2 = 0 -> none -> tie -> bank0.
check("dispatch-tie", cfg,
      [[0, "enqueue", 1, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "dequeue", 0, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []],
       [1, "dequeue", 1, 1, 1, 5, 0, 0, []]])

# E: fifo policy counter advances on rejected attempts too

       [2, "dequeue", 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, []],
       [3, "dequeue", 1, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []]],
      None)

# F: automatic sample right after admission reaching period
cfg = {"banks": 1, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 100,

check("auto-sample", cfg,

       [1, "enqueue", 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "sample", [2], [2]]],
      None)

# G: sample normalization translates rows by min over q
cfg = {"banks": 2, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 100,
       "refill_batch": 1, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 5, 20],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "events": [["sample"]]}
check("sample-bias", cfg, [[0, "sample", [2, 1], [2, 1]]],
      {"tick": 0, "load_balancer": 0, "service_bank": 0, "sample_progress": 0,
       "borders": [0, 5, 20], "counters": [[[0, 0], [0, 0]]], "history": [2, 1],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "queues": [{"fifo": [], "pifo": [], "fifo_bytes": 0, "pifo_bytes": 0},
                  {"fifo": [], "pifo": [], "fifo_bytes": 0, "pifo_bytes": 0}],
       "lags": []})

# H: repartition migration of the initial bias: [0,5,20) -> [0,10,20)
cfg = {"banks": 2, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 100,
       "refill_batch": 1, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 5, 20],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "events": [["repartition", [0, 10, 20]]]}
# old C rows: l0 q0 [1,1]?? compute: C[l][q][r]=1 iff q < r mod 2: r=0: none (r%2=0)
# r=1: q=0 -> 1. so row q0 = [0,1], q1=[0,0]. X would be [0,1].
# migrate q0 vector [0,1] from [0,5,20) to [0,10,20):
#  old [0,5) mass 0 -> 0. old [5,20) mass 1, b=5, span=15:
#   new [0,10): floor(1*clamp(10-5,0,15)/15) - floor(1*clamp(0-5,0,15)/15) = floor(5/15)-0 = 0
#   new [10,20): floor(1*clamp(15,0,15)/15) - floor(1*clamp(5,0,15)/15) = 1 - 0 = 1
#  -> [0,1]; q1 -> [0,0]. H [0,0] -> [0,0]
check("repartition-bias", cfg, [[0, "repartition", 2]],
      {"tick": 0, "load_balancer": 0, "service_bank": 0, "sample_progress": 0,
       "borders": [0, 10, 20], "counters": [[[0, 1], [0, 0]]], "history": [0, 0],
       "policy": {"kind": "sff"},
       "queues": [{"fifo": [], "pifo": [], "fifo_bytes": 0, "pifo_bytes": 0},
                  {"fifo": [], "pifo": [], "fifo_bytes": 0, "pifo_bytes": 0}],
       "lags": []})

# I: wfq quantized finish tags and V update
cfg = {"banks": 1, "load_balancers": 1, "fifo_bytes": 100, "pifo_bytes": 100,
       "refill_batch": 1, "sample_period": 100, "borders": [0, 1000000000],
       "policy": {"kind": "wfq", "weights": [[1, 3], [2, 1]]},
       "events": [["enqueue", 1, 1, 1, 0], ["enqueue", 2, 2, 1, 0],
                  ["weight", 1, 1], ["enqueue", 3, 1, 1, 0], ["dequeue", 1]]}
# F[1] = 0+ceil(1*1048576/3) = 349526 ; F[2] = 1048576 ; weight update;
# F[1] = max(349526,0)+ceil(1048576/1)=1388102 ; service: lowest rank=349526 (id1) -> V=349526
check("wfq-tags", cfg,
      [[0, "enqueue", 1, 349526, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [1, "enqueue", 2, 1048576, 0, 0, 0, True],
       [2, "weight", 1, 1],
       [3, "enqueue", 3, 1388102, 0, 0, 0, True],
